crossRefs.note: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
Aren’t you from everlasting, Yahweh my God, my Holy One? We will not die. Yahweh, you have appointed him for judgment.…
You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal…
Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?

translations.web: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.
translations.bsb: Indeed, it is true that God does not act wickedly, and the Almighty does not pervert justice.
translations.kjv: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.
translations.asv: Yea, of a surety, God will not do wickedly, Neither will the Almighty pervert justice.
